# The entering orbit of the coupled entry layer (generated by experiments/theory3y_run.py)

Round theory3, direction Y.  Statements and proofs: the round note (outside the repository), Theorems E0-E4; this report is the numerical side: the layer flow of the block and the entrant integrated from the dormant state (library `theory3y_entry.py`), checked against the constants of the theorems.  Continuum Gram (Z = 1), n = 1, Gaussian features, Omega = 0 (no dormant kernel in the layer), the repository law (m, G, gamma, a_max) = (12, 1, 0.1, 1).

## A. The hypotheses and the constants

Every entry layer (k-th entry) of the 8 targets of theory3n (set D: `(K,sep,R,seed)/k`) and of 8 further targets drawn from a fixed generator (set R: K in {2, 3}, separation 5.5-9.5 widths, amplitude ratio 1-2.4) and 16 stress layers (set S: second layers of K = 2 targets built at Delta = 4.9, 5.2, 5.6 widths, R = 1, 2.4, the entrant 0.40 widths from its feature toward the formed unit; label `(2,Delta,R,code)`, code = 100 weak feature first + 10 opposite signs + 1).  `regime` = the box conditions (L) v_lo > 0, (C) psi(r) > E_c, (N-hat) nu = lambda_own(d-hat) - H_c > 0 with positive lower faces of the relaxation set, in ball arithmetic (exp_theory_t1.box_t1, midpoints printed), at the smallest grid radius r > d0 (step 0.05).  Layers outside the regime are not covered by the theorems and are not integrated.

## B. Layer flows from the dormant state (eps > 0)

The network's own flow of the block and the entrant: the entrant at x = 0 (w = 0 exactly), the block at the previous critical point, integrated (Radau, rtol 1e-11) until the entrant reaches the level w_# = a_min v_lo / 2 (the first crossing, time t_#) and 4000 time units further.  Times below are measured from t_# (a fast time; t_# itself is the pre-layer, of order eps^(-1/2)).  `checks` = all of: the box |d| < r and v <= v_bar, the block above v_lo, the entrant nondecreasing until it reaches v_lo and above v_lo afterwards, the block inside the relaxation set D-hat throughout, the tail of Lemma E0 (w_e(s)^(-1/3) >= w_#^(-1/3) + c_M w_# |s|/3 for s <= 0), and the decay of Theorem E4 (|y - y_hat| <= sqrt(H_up/nu) |y(t_hat) - y_hat| exp(-rho (s - t_hat)) for s >= t_hat, slack 1e-9).  `t_hat` = the first time from which every unit stays in D-hat; `bound` = T_2 + T_3 (balls); `t_D*` = the time from which every unit stays in D*, its bound t_hat + ln(sqrt(H_up/nu) diam(D-hat) / margin)/rho (Theorem E3(iii), a priori); nan for K = 1 (d-tilde = 0: D* is the face d = 0, entered only asymptotically).

## C. The limit object's layer: flows from v_0 -> 0 (eps = 0), time-aligned

The flow of the critical curve (eps = 0) started at w_e = v_0 a_min with the block at the previous critical point, aligned at the first crossing of w_#.  `distance` = sup over the aligned window s in [-0.9 t_#(v_0), 4000] of the distance in (v', d) to the reference flow v_0 = 1e-14 (a Cauchy sequence if the entering orbit is unique up to a time shift).  The checks of part B are applied to every flow (the bound is that of eps = 0).

## What this report does and does not show

* It integrates the layer flow itself (not a least-squares polish) from the dormant state at eps = 1e-6 ... 1e-12 and from v_0 = 1e-3 ... 1e-12 at eps = 0, on the layers in the regime, and checks the box, the monotone entry, the hitting time of the relaxation set against T_2 + T_3 and the decay against rho.  A check is not a proof: the proofs are in the note; a violation here would be a bug of a theorem.
* The constants are those of Prop. A / THEORY_T1.md evaluated in ball arithmetic (midpoints printed), T_2, T_3, rho in balls from those midpoints; the flows are floating point.
* Layers outside the regime (Delta below Prop. A's threshold or d0 >= the admissible radius) and K > 3, n > 1, sampled Grams, unequal masses, noise are not covered.
